'''Cullen Burns HuntDown is not dead''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Cullen Burns]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-9765">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9765 HuntDown is not dead], DeckTech (Cullen "Sigmar" Burns, 22 August 2000).
